text: I'm recommending the Tomato and Basil Orzo Salad to you because it fits perfectly with your preferences and dietary needs. As a vegetarian, you'll love the fresh basil and juicy tomatoes in this dish, and the orzo pasta is a great source of complex carbohydrates. The recipe is also quick and easy to make, taking only about 35 minutes to prepare, which fits within your 45-minute time budget. Plus, it's nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any allergens. This salad is a great way to enjoy a light and satisfying meal that's packed with flavor.
